scenes.title: One more thing, baby
scenes.message: {{girlfriendName}}, your surprise is a reminder: Even if we have our disagreements, our big fights, tiny quarels and everything in between, I will always love you. Together or apart, I will always be your cutie baby. I will always be your boyfriend, and I will always be here for you. I love you, {{girlfriendName}}.

chapters.title: Chapter 4 · A Message From My Heart

scenes.speaker: {{boyfriendName}}
scenes.title: Just us
scenes.text:
I hope you know how much I appreciate you, for the things you have done for me, for us, for our relationship to work even if it's not perfect, if the pain was too much, you still chose to stay. 

 I'm sorry baby, I've seen your repost and notes about how you feel, I'm sorry for being such a bad person love, I know you're tired of hearing this over and over and over again, I love you. You know baby, If ayaw mo na talaga you can tell me after this, I promise what ever you decide I'll respect it(sana hindi mag  bulag). 

Thank you for being my favorite person to laugh with, talk to, and do absolutely nothing with. I love getting to know every version of you, and I’m grateful for every month we get to call this *our story*.

Happy monthsary, baby. I love you, today, tomorrow, and on all the days in between. To more memories, more laughter, and more love. I love you, {{girlfriendName}}. (no bulag please huhu)

scenes.title: I love you!
scenes.message:
Thanks for playing our little story, {{girlfriendName}}.

You are my favorite plot twist, my best friend, and the person I want beside me for every next chapter.

Happy monthsary. ♡
